limitations: Only the three exact verified x86-64 little-endian ELF producer layouts qualify.
Only default literal and primitive Display printing is recovered; repeated indices, explicit specifications, generic and floating callbacks remain runtime calls.
Primitive execution compares unchanged macro expressions with explicit typed input bindings; complete primitive setup is not claimed recompilable.
The original stripped angr fmt fixture has no recovered print sink identities and remains unchanged.
Older format!/panic!/write! consumers, symbol recovery and full Go/Rust parity remain separate work.
